name: Stella
source: The other Star Miko of the Tower of Power. She also doubles as a maid. Stella is an AI within a human's body; while she weighs only 48 kg, she sinks to the ground whenever her power is out or she's broken. Stella has a emergency stop on her neck, which makes her completely stop functioning and also a limiter which stops her from harming humans, unless she is reprogrammed to do so. Stella is rather curious about humans, and tries her best to act like one.
